title: ECB Official EUR FX Rates, Policy Rates, Inflation & Invoice Converter Input

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Select which ECB feeds/tools to run: fx_rates, policy_rates, hicp_inflation, invoice_converter.

currencies.title: Currencies (against EUR)
currencies.description: ISO 4217 currency codes for ECB EUR reference exchange rates.

lastNObservations.title: Last N observations per series
lastNObservations.description: Number of recent observations to retrieve per currency/indicator.

startPeriod.title: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)
startPeriod.description: Optional start date for historical FX series.

endPeriod.title: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)
endPeriod.description: Optional end date for historical FX series.

inflationAreas.title: HICP Inflation Reference Areas
inflationAreas.description: Euro area (U2) and EU Member State codes for monthly HICP annual inflation rates.

invoices.title: Invoices to convert (for invoice_converter mode)
invoices.description: Array of { invoiceId, amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency, date } objects to convert using official ECB reference rates.
